lines: The atom soon attains pure lordly knowing;
its mover Śiva to be known, all-knowing, bestowing.
l4.sanskrit_cite: aṇur viśuddham acirād aisvaraṃ jñānam aśnute | taccodakaḥ śivo jñeyaḥ sarvajñaḥ parameśvaraḥ
